title: Wood Blocks to Logs
description: A recipe to convert wood blocks back to regular logs.
body:
Convert wood blocks to logs with a simple recipe. Useful for worldgen datapacks that replace a lot of logs with these blocks. Works on all wood types.

![Minecraft crafting grid showing four oak wood blocks. The output is 4 oak logs.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/634cad15a7db49959c765e58bf69cbb2ddbf98f9.png)
